title: 第十六章 智取神功第十七章 城外等你
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
兴云庄依山傍水，门庭森严，比寻常江东园林多了几分粗犷。乃是天下持剑六派之一东海剑庄位于郢城的别院。
剑气冲霄堂内，上首端坐一人，二十一二岁，目光如剑，身材高大的青年。
青年脸上挂着浅浅的笑容，仿佛世间没有何事能难倒他。
他便是雄踞人榜第一之位，一年多的‘无形剑’何九，东海剑庄的少庄主。
身穿深蓝色家丁袍的老者弯腰进来，禀报道：“少庄主，江湖最近有一则传闻。”
“何事？”
何九端坐。
“有一山野村人，不过二十上下，刚一横空出世就一招败了三十五位的‘剑下无错’，自称‘外景之下第一高手’。”
深蓝色家丁袍的老者恭恭敬敬的诉说着。
“一招败‘剑下无错’？人榜前二十者都能做到。”
何九脸上浅浅笑容不变的看着老者，他知道还有后续。
“当时，有绝顶高手路遇这场决斗，点出此人已然归真返璞。”
老者的话语仿佛一道惊雷，使得何九淡定从容的内心不再平静。
他雄踞人榜第一的位置一年多，此时还处于天人合一之境，距离之上的归真返璞不知还需多少时日，没想到此刻惊闻有年轻一辈迈入此境。
他之所以强压境界没有晋升半步外景，就是在思考自己的道路，调整内天地，使身心最为契合，使它们与外天地产生的共鸣最强。到时候一旦突破，水到渠成，道基稳固，突飞猛进。
浅浅的笑容渐渐变成大笑，何九道：“那我便要去试一试这位‘外景之下第一高手’有何斤两，如若属实，这人榜第一不要也罢。”
微微停顿，何九吩咐道：“时刻关注此人消息，我要知道他此刻在何地。”
他有担忧，怕自身去的晚了，对方就会一步登天，成就外景，到时候就无法见识到返璞归真之境了。
“少庄主无需心急，据他自身所言，外出游历是为寻得高深功法，一时片刻不会内外交汇成就外景。”
一旦自身内景外显，与外天地内外交汇成就外景，肉身、元神随之改变，心灵升华，道基铸成，再无退路。日后再获得神功也难以彻底转换根本功法，终究会留下瑕疵，只能将功法发挥出八成威力，若是和自身冲突极大的神功，能发挥出其三成威力已是幸事。

谓之‘玄关无悔’。
……
深夜，星光璀璨。皎洁完满的圆月似是月神之眸，俯瞰大地。
馗城是郢城附近的一座小城。
当地有一小门派，名为聚华派，门中弟子多为开了五六窍者。
最近几天，聚华派黄世涛掌门外出时，在乞丐堆中发现一名十三四岁的少年乞儿，他见之少年根骨不同寻常，将其收入门下带回聚华派。
段瑞直到现在还是不敢相信自己竟然脱离朝不保夕，有上顿没下顿，常常被恶乞欺负恐吓的生活。
content_en:
Xingyun Villa is surrounded by mountains and rivers, with a strict gate and courtyard, and is a bit more rough than the ordinary Jiangdong gardens. It is the annex of Donghai Jianzhuang located in Yingcheng, one of the six sword-holding sects in the world.
In the Sword Qi Chongxiao Hall, there was a tall young man sitting at the head, twenty-one or twelve years old, with eyes like swords.
There was a slight smile on the young man's face, as if nothing in the world could trouble him.
He is the "Invisible Sword" He Jiu who has been at the top of the list for more than a year and is the young master of Donghai Sword Village.
The old man wearing a dark blue servant's robe stooped in and reported: "Young Master, there is a rumor in Jianghu recently."
"What's the matter?"
He Jiu sat upright.
"There is a mountain villager who is only around 20 years old. He defeated thirty-five people with one move in one move and called himself 'the best master in outdoor scenes'."
The old man in dark blue servant robe spoke respectfully.
"Defeat 'Nothing Wrong with the Sword' in one move? The top twenty people on the list can do it."
He Jiu looked at the old man with a slight smile on his face, knowing that there would be a follow-up.
"At that time, a top master encountered this duel on the road, and it was pointed out that this person had returned to his true nature."
The old man's words were like a thunder, which made He Jiu's calm and calm heart no longer calm.
He has been at the top of the list for more than a year. At this time, he is still in the realm of unity between nature and man. It is unknown how long it will take to return to his true nature and return to his original nature. Unexpectedly, he was shocked to hear that a younger generation has entered this realm.
The reason why he suppressed his realm and did not advance even half a step to the exterior scene was that he was thinking about his own path, adjusting the inner world and the earth to make the body and mind the most consistent, so that they resonate the strongest with the outer world. Once a breakthrough is made, it will be a matter of course, the foundation will be solid, and progress will be made by leaps and bounds.
The shallow smile gradually turned into a laugh, and He Jiu said: "Then I'm going to try to see how worthy this 'number one master on location' is. If it's true, I don't mind if he's number one on the list."
After a slight pause, He Jiu ordered: "Always pay attention to this person's news. I want to know where he is at the moment."
He is worried that if he goes too late, the other party will reach the sky in one fell swoop and achieve outdoor scenes, and then he will not be able to experience the state of returning to his original nature.
"Young master, there is no need to be anxious. According to what he said, he travels to find profound skills. He will not be able to interact with the inside and outside to achieve the external scene for a moment."
Once one's inner scene is revealed to the outside, and the inner and outer scenes interact with the outer world to create the outer scene, the physical body and soul will change accordingly, the soul will be sublimated, and the foundation of the Tao will be forged, and there will be no way out. In the future, it will be difficult to completely transform the basic skills if you obtain magical skills. In the end, flaws will remain, and you can only use 80% of the power of the skills. If it is a magical skill that greatly conflicts with yourself, it is a blessing to be able to use 30% of its power.
It’s called ‘no regrets at the entrance’.
…
Late at night, the stars are shining brightly. The bright, full moon looks like the eyes of the moon god, overlooking the earth.
Kuicheng is a small city near Yingcheng.
There is a small local sect called Juhua Sect, and most of its disciples are those who have opened five or six orifices.
In recent days, when Huang Shitao, the head of the Juhua Sect, was out, he found a 13-14-year-old young beggar among the beggars. He saw that the boy had unusual bones and took him under his disciples and brought him back to the Juhua Sect.
Duan Rui still can't believe that he has escaped from a life of precarious life, where he never had a meal and was often bullied and intimidated by evil beggars.
